body.x: BenjiLock unveiled world’s first rechargeable padlock with fingerprint technology at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

The padlock, developed by BenjiLock, can be embedded in ways of hybrid security solutions and can go beyond the traditional ones. It is the world’s first rechargeable padlock with fingerprint technology that can store and recognize up to four unique fingerprints. Its stainless steel construction ensures maximum durability. The consumers can secure their property using this hybrid technology fitting to their lifestyle in a practical way.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
